# VB Decompiler

> A professional decompiler and reverse engineering tool for recovering source code from Visual Basic 6.0 and C# .NET applications.

VB Decompiler is a specialized tool developed by DotFix Software that enables developers and security researchers to analyze, recover, and understand compiled Visual Basic and .NET applications. The platform supports multiple decompilation targets including P-Code, Native Code, C#, and MS IL, with advanced features for malware analysis, code tracing, and AI-assisted code recovery.
